purpose: Teach: びん/左足/トホホ/デブ/キュート/フレンドリー/カミさん/姑

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがガラスのびんに花を活けて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad arranged flowers in that glass bottle, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Voice carries a small smile of affection. Speaks as though sharing something tender she's just witnessed. Gentle pace, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに左足の使い方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me how to use my left foot better.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Not boasting, just reporting something that mattered to him. Clear eyes. Voice stays steady and small, the way he delivers important news.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「トホホ」と笑って下さるのが好きよ
lines.en: Sho — I love how Dad laughs like that, you know? That 'toho-ho' thing.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverie-like. Speaking about something she's heard many times and loves each time. Soft, unhurried. A small exhale of genuine affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、デブにならない様に運動してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm making sure I stay fit so I don't get out of shape.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly self-conscious. Not seeking praise. Speaks it like a responsibility he's taking seriously. Quiet but deliberate, the words settling flat.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが描いた絵、キュートで素敵よ
lines.en: Sho — the drawings your dad makes are really cute and lovely.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Not performing praise. Speaking about something she's noticed and honestly likes. Warm, easy tone. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さん、お友達にフレンドリーに接して下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad is really friendly with his friends, isn't he.
lines.style: Small, earnest observation. Not seeking confirmation, just noticing something he's proud of. Voice is clear but doesn't push. The ease of someone stating what he knows.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがママを「カミさん」と呼んで下さるわよ
lines.en: Sho — Dad calls your mom 'the missus' sometimes — it's kind of charming.
lines.style: Soft, amused affection in the voice. Speaking about a small habit she finds endearing. Tone is intimate, like sharing something she's fond of. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さん、姑、つまりお祖母ちゃんと仲良いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad gets along really well with Grandma — your mom-in-law, I mean.
lines.style: Simple statement of something that pleases him. Voice carries no doubt. Speaks it like a fact he's observed and respects. Steady, quiet, the words landing with calm certainty.
